annotations.title: Chase capital calls and check payment instructions for a change

description: Capital call collection chasing for syndicators and small funds. Send the call's due date, optional grace days and chase schedule, and per investor a label, the amount called and the amount received. Get back who is paid, partly paid, due, in grace or overdue, who is due a chase today, the chase dates, and draft wording per stage (nothing is sent). Optionally send the payment instructions printed on the call notice (routing number or IBAN, last 4 of the account, names; never a full account number): you get the routing-number and IBAN check-digit results and a fingerprint; send it back as previous_instruction_fingerprint on the next call to learn whether the instructions changed (the usual sign of payment-redirect fraud). Set check_sources true to also read two public FBI and FinCEN pages and, with sec_cik, the SEC EDGAR record for Form D filings. Free. No model, nothing stored, signed record. Up to 100 investors. Use your own investor labels, not names, emails or account numbers. Not legal, tax or investment advice; your fund documents decide default and remedies.

as_of.description: Date to evaluate on (default today, UTC).

call_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the call notice was issued (optional).

chase_offsets_days.description: Days from the due date on which to chase (negative = before). Default [-5, 0, 3, 7, 14].

check_sources.description: Also read the FBI IC3 and FinCEN pages (and EDGAR if sec_cik is sent) and report what they say today.

currency.description: Three capital letters, e.g. USD (shape only, not checked against the ISO list).

fingerprint_salt.description: A random phrase you make up just for this tool (16+ characters, not a password, API key or any existing credential), the same each time, mixed into the fingerprint so nobody else can reproduce it. Not stored.

fund_label.description: Your own label for the fund or deal (not a person).

grace_days.description: Days after the due date before an unpaid amount counts as overdue. Your own number from your fund documents (default 0).

amount_called.description: At most 2 decimals. As text ("1250.50") if you want it exact.

investor_id.description: Your own label, e.g. LP-07. Not a name, email or account number.

last_reminder_date.description: When you last chased this investor (optional).

payment_instructions.description: The payment instructions printed on the call notice. Never a full account number.

previous_instruction_fingerprint.description: instruction_fingerprint from your last check of these instructions.

sec_cik.description: SEC CIK of the fund or issuer; with check_sources, reports whether a Form D is on file.
